items.text: Senior Machine Learning Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing, training, and operating large-scale personalized recommendation and search ranking systems in Python and PyTorch.

entries.heading: Senior ML Engineer, Personalization | Lumen Commerce | 2022 – Present

items.text: Architected and deployed a multi-stage homepage recommendation and search ranking pipeline in Python and PyTorch serving 18M daily active shoppers, lifting click-through rate (CTR) by 7.4%.
Built and operated an online feature store using Feast backed by Redis Cluster and Kafka streaming ingestion, serving 140+ real-time user-item interaction features with 99.95% availability.
Quantized two-tower and DLRM scoring models to FP16 on NVIDIA Triton Inference Server, cutting p99 scoring response time from 62ms to 19ms at 28,000 QPS during peak holiday traffic.
Ran 30+ split-traffic randomized trials for feed ranking algorithms using CUPED pre-experiment covariate adjustment and automated latency/diversity circuit-breakers, driving a +4.2% lift in net GMV.
Mitigated position bias in click-through-rate (CTR) prediction models using inverse propensity weighting and shallow tower dropout, improving calibration (ECE reduced from 0.041 to 0.012).
Indexed 45M catalog item embeddings in Faiss HNSW and ScaNN indices for candidate generation, achieving 0.96 recall@100 within a 6ms retrieval budget.
Authored distributed point-in-time feature join and training dataset generation jobs in PySpark on GCP Dataproc and BigQuery, processing 4.5TB of daily impression logs.
Implemented request coalescing and embedding cache warming in the Go/Python ranking gateway, keeping p95 end-to-end latency under 32ms during flash-sale traffic spikes.
Coached 3 new-grad hires and 2 interns from onboarding to first production launch; chaired weekly RFC architecture critiques for the 14-person personalization group.
Replaced separate click and purchase scorers with a shared-bottom multi-gate mixture-of-experts network trained with listwise ranking objectives in PyTorch, lifting conversion 2.8%.
Trained gradient-boosted ranking models (LightGBM) for sponsored products CTR prediction across 8M SKUs, increasing ad revenue per search session by 5.1%.
Orchestrated daily model retraining, shadow evaluation, and canary rollout workflows on GCP Vertex AI and Airflow with automated data-drift gates.
Reduced offline nightly backfill pipeline runtime from 9 hours to 3.5 hours by repartitioning Parquet tables and tuning PySpark shuffle partitions.
Partnered with merchant ops to onboard 1,200 brick-and-mortar partner stores into the regional same-day delivery catalog.
Collaborated with the C++ core search engine team to define Protobuf contracts and payload schemas for candidate handoff.
Built real-time feature freshness monitors in Prometheus and Grafana, paging on-call when Kafka consumer lag exceeded 90 seconds.
Handled primary on-call rotations for the recommendation scoring service, authoring 12 runbooks and leading blameless postmortems after a Redis cluster failover incident.
Implemented a deterministic business-rule reranking filter to enforce brand-safety, cold-start impression quotas, and seller diversity constraints post-scoring.
Evaluated RBF and polynomial kernels in legacy scikit-learn SVM baselines during a deprecation audit of heritage fraud heuristics.
Sparked cross-org adoption of standardized model cards and lineage tracking across 4 product squads.
Ran 120+ offline hyperparameter grid-search experiments in Weights & Biases to tune cosine annealing learning rate schedules.
Participated in an internal 2-day hackathon exploring prompt templates for customer support ticket routing (prototype only, not shipped).
